title: Existence of the integral closure of the structure sheaf inside a quasi-coherent algebra on an algebraic space
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Algebraic Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an algebraic space X over S and a quasi-coherent sheaf of O_X-algebras A, there is a quasi-coherent subsheaf A' whose value on every affine object U of X_etale is the integral closure of O_X(U) in A(U) (source lines 9934-9943). The construction is by gluing the scheme case: on each U in X_etale the restriction A|_U is a quasi-coherent sheaf of algebras on a scheme, so the scheme version of integral closure applies, and the compatibility needed to glue is that for every etale morphism f : U' -> U the canonical isomorphism f^*(A'_U) = A'_{U'} holds, which is supplied by the smooth pullback lemma for integral closures. The proof then checks that the resulting subpresheaf is a Zariski sheaf with the required values and that it is quasi-coherent on X_etale.
